item.title: Self-Hosted Minecraft Server Platforms: PaperMC vs Purpur vs Fabric
item.description: Running a self-hosted Minecraft server gives you complete control over gameplay rules, performance tuning, mod selection, and player access. While Mojang provides an official vanilla server, the community has developed several high-performance server platforms that dramatically improve gameplay, add configurability, and enable mod support. This guide compares three leading open-source Minecraft server platforms: PaperMC, Purpur, and Fabric.
